description: Kaplan-Meier cumulative incidence step curve (journal figure, 709x424 JPEG). Hand-labelled by pixel analysis; positions are image pixels, origin top-left, +/- ~1 px.

xAxis.notes: Very faint 3-px tick marks below the axis line (grey ~170-200 on white, rows 346-348) at every label; positions are label centres, within 1 px of the marks.

yAxis.notes: Faint short tick marks left of the axis line. Labels formatted 0.00-1.00.

knownValues.description: Final plateau of the curve (figure annotation '5 years: 16.2%')
Curve sits on y = 0 before the first step

pitfalls: Rotated y-axis title text at columns ~95-99 is darker than the axis line and fools naive column-darkness detection.
Caption text rows ~401-406 are darker than the x-axis line and fool naive row-darkness detection.
The '+' censoring markers along the curve are not data steps.
The x tick marks are so faint they were first labelled as absent (Phase 4 measured them at every label: columns 134, 211, 288, 365, 442, 519, 596).
